parsed.name: Phidget热电偶温度传感器
parsed.description: 用于通过热电偶测量温度的传感器设备，可用于实验装置、样品或环境的温度采集与连续监测。
parsed.description_en: A thermocouple-based temperature sensing device used to measure and continuously monitor the temperature of experimental setups, samples, or the environment.

actions.description: 连接热电偶温度传感器并等待设备就绪。
actions.description_en: Connect to the thermocouple temperature sensor and wait for the device to become ready.

actions.description: 断开与热电偶温度传感器的连接。
actions.description_en: Disconnect from the thermocouple temperature sensor.
